name: Edit profile
annotation: HIFI-50 · /profile/edit · Dark shell, #0A0A0F base + top-center orange radial atmosphere. AvatarGlassInput and the hero completeness GlassStatCard are the singular focal moment; Identity/Contact sections stay quiet and legible; Demographics + Delete account sit below the fold; one sticky Save changes CTA.

modules.build: iOS status bar: time left, signal/wifi/battery right, paper-100 icons on #0A0A0F warm-dark shell with top-center orange radial atmosphere (18%) and grain. Fixed 44px, no copy.
TopBar, transparent on load, gains .glass-pill backdrop on scroll. Left: BtnGhost chevron-left (back, 44px target). Center: H2 'Edit profile'. Right: BtnGhost glyph action (44px target).

AvatarGlassInput (NEW) 96px centered, circular .glass-card mask + bottom-right .glass-pill camera glyph (44px hit target). Caption below: 'change photo'. Real: image renders + ChipProvenance 'via camera roll'. Honest-null: empty ring + 'tap to add photo'. a11y: 'Profile photo, double tap to change'.

GlassStatCard (variant: metric), hero-sized. Overline 'PROFILE'. Primary '6 of 8 complete'. ProgressBar 8px, 75% orange fill. Subtext: '2 left to *personalise* CIA'. ChipProvenance 'you logged'. Glow: purple #7F24FF breathe (55%->70%, 4s ease infinite), sweeps to green #34A853 (glow-done) permanently at 8/8. a11y traits: updatesFrequently.

SectionHeader 'IDENTITY'. GlassPillInput (text): 'First name'. GlassPillInput (text): 'Last name'. GlassPillInput (multiline, radius 20): 'About you (optional)', placeholder 'tell CIA what matters right now'.

SectionHeader 'CONTACT'. ListRow (disabled, no chevron): Label 'Email', trailing ChipProvenance 'email verified' + BtnGhost copy-icon (44px, a11y 'Copy email address', confirms 'Copied'). GlassPillInput (text, keyboard tel): 'Phone', placeholder '+971 50 123 4567'.

Sticky glass action zone docked above home indicator. BtnPrimary 'Save changes', disabled 40% opacity until a valid dirty change exists. Success: flashes --glow-done green + light haptic, holds 250ms, then stack-pops to Me Main.

belowFold.build: SectionHeader 'DEMOGRAPHICS'. ListRow (value, chevron, opens Sheet): 'Date of birth' -> '1 Jan 1996'. ListRow: 'Gender' -> 'prefer not to say'. ListRow: 'Timezone' -> 'Asia/Dubai'. Light haptic on each tap.
BtnGhost centered: 'Delete account' (destructive tint). Confirmation required; heavy impact haptic fires only on confirmed deletion.

imageSlots.description: avatar or message attachment slot; screen-specific; premium warm-dark product placeholder.
imageSlots.prompt: 50-profile-edit avatar or social proof placeholders, Balencia warm-dark glass UI asset, privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text.

trustControls: 50-profile-edit exposes audience, visibility, report, mute, block, and own-content delete controls before sharing or social comparison
ConsentCard shown on first tap of 'change photo', before the native OS picker opens — required by CANON 8 for any screen touching photo data
Source chips include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete
Profile completeness carries the full honesty pair: real '6 of 8 complete' + ChipProvenance 'you logged'; honest-null '0 of 8 complete' + 'next: add a photo' — no fabricated percentage
Avatar status: real = image renders + ChipProvenance 'via camera roll'; honest-null = empty ring + 'tap to add photo' (not a full-screen EmptyState)

Every ListRow (email, DOB, gender, timezone) and the AvatarGlassInput camera glyph honor a 44x44px minimum hit target; disabled 'Save changes' still announces 'Save disabled, 2 fields left to complete' to screen readers
Copy-email BtnGhost announces 'Copy email address' on focus and confirms 'Copied' on success, not just a silent visual toast
Route stays aligned to /profile/edit only — no alternate vanity routes
notes: New component: AvatarGlassInput — 96px circular .glass-card-tier mask + bottom-right .glass-pill camera glyph; promote to catalog only if reused (Me Main uses a plain avatar).

DO NOT use full-screen EmptyState for Day-1; Day-1 preserves already-populated name/email from sign-up while avatar, phone, DOB, gender, timezone, and about-you sit at honest-null (ListRow placeholder 'not set ->').
Validation error rings flash #FF5E00 with matching inline error text — color is never the sole signal.
Haptics: light selection feedback on every ListRow tap and each keyboard 'Next' step; heavy impact haptic on confirmed account deletion only.
Completeness GlassStatCard glow-cia breathes (4s ease, 55%->70% opacity) while CIA reads input; breathe stops permanently once it sweeps to glow-done at 8/8.

Skeleton sweeps --surface-3 blocks over avatar, completeness card, and input geometries; reduced motion: entrance staggers and glow breathe cease instantly, ProgressBar snaps to final width, success 250ms hold is skipped.
Fonts: Hanken Grotesk (UI) + Newsreader Medium Italic (emphasis word) stand in for Neue Montreal/Tiempos per session waiver W-FONT-01 — supersedes this spec's own Visual System font references.
